ms.promise:
・Document describing the coordination algorithm of the Validators belonging to the decentralized network
・Algorthm implementation with 2 Validators
ms.criteria:
・Document describes how the algorithm works and what are the possible future improvements
・2 validators behave as intended to choose which test transaction to submit to the blockchain in each moment
ms.report:
Hello reviewers!
Here are the outputs done for this Milestone:
・The document explaining how we decided the coordination algorithm of the Aquarium validators is the ReadMe file of the official repo: https://github.com/FluidTokens/ft-cardano-aquarium-sc
・Preprod transactions where 2 Aquarium validators register:
・https://preprod.cexplorer.io/tx/332038e642ea621ae83bb2a2595c319a92104daeecc436bec62ba6539ff46196
・https://preprod.cexplorer.io/tx/4a69e20a1e8adf8d27e223996544e8f2ba2aeb1eb9844bc96cf8cbae8291e721
・Preprod transactions automatically executed by the 2 validators:
・https://preprod.cexplorer.io/tx/e729bc5b35b4e2d230f145a0dc768f1a09679393a5ba82fd00629445c7b9ebcd
・https://preprod.cexplorer.io/tx/f1bb02a7b4eb1d786a9a89a4fe93ed05cad4bb22e080bbe2fb59ed8a2b5f634f

Just to be clear: the "Nodes coordination algorithm" chapter is what explains how the Aquarium nodes coordinate, in particular they don't actually coordinate but instead participate in a game of who is quicker in executing the promised/scheduled transactions. At the end the revenues are shared proportionally offchain to all the nodes.
Please let us know if all is clear, the next milestone will finalize the frontend and audit the contracts!
